title: Add closure environment drop glue

Thread spawn currently frees its outer runner environment and cleans it on pthread_create failure, but nested task closure environments still rely on this missing compiler support.

acceptance_criteria: Closures implement the correct callable traits; Send/Sync are derived structurally including captured values; safe spawn rejects non-Send, non-static captures and non-Send results; JoinHandle joins and returns the thread result; focused compiler and integration tests pass.

A method currently written like @==: Self -> T -> R should be written as @==: T -> R; the compiler should inject the receiver type internally for processing and handle @, ^@, and ~@ receiver differences automatically. This should align Eq and Hash-style traits with Rust-like non-consuming receiver semantics where appropriate and eliminate the need for separate EqRef and HashRef traits added as a workaround for borrowed HashMap key probing.
